quotes.tex:
A countable collection of languages $\cL = \inbrace{L_1,L_2,\ldots}$ over some countable domain
    $\cX$ admits an algorithm that detects hallucinations in the limit if and only if $\cL$ is 
    identifiable in the limit.

Every countable collection of languages $\cL = \inbrace{L_1,L_2,\ldots}$ over some countable domain
    $\cX$ admits an algorithm that, given negative examples, detects hallucinations in the limit.
